description: Second connection: confirm the RPG III/DDS generator features added for Part 5 (tools/gen/rpg3.mjs E-spec/DS, tools/gen/dspf.mjs conditioning indicators + SFL) actually compile on PUB400. T0EDS is compiled AND run (no divide, no interactive I/O, so no hang risk - prints via QSYSPRT/EXCPT like the already-verified r0412s.rpg). T0SFL is compile-only (CRTDSPF): interactive subfile behavior needs a real 5250 device and cannot be checked over SSH batch (same V1-only limitation as lesson 04-11). Run after harness-selftest confirms the transfer/CCSID/INQMSGRPY basics.
